dex.entry: When a Wispwane is loved and re-kindled, the Hollowing's taint burns away and it blazes back as a radiant wisp of pure light — joyful, fast, and full of a renewed warmth. The kindling evolution IS the narrative — recovering a drained kin back to full brilliance is the game's whole theme in one line.

art.silhouette: A now-healthy glowing orb, bright amber-white, streaming a long comet-tail of light-motes; a beaming face visible in its core; no dark shadow remains; moves with joyful swooping arcs; reads as a blazing meteor-head at 48px.
